name: Sense CMS LinkedIn Publisher
author: QUANT Software House Limited
description: Publishes reviewed Sense CMS posts to connected LinkedIn member profiles.

changelog.summary: Align account cards, connection metadata, empty state and publishing workflow with the shared Social Publishing interface.
Close the OAuth window after return even when the provider has isolated it from the opener.
Connect multiple LinkedIn member profiles and publish reviewed article-link posts through the official Share on LinkedIn API.
